summary: Static React+Vite+Tailwind frontend, no DB/API layers needed. Chain depth per feature is shallow: most features are UI-only (component -> integration into page), no backend/state-management chain required beyond React Router.

revisions.reason: Earth (via /agent-team-swe re-invocation) requested 2 small polish fixes after v2 shipped: (1) outer preview-card wrapper (bg/shadow only) should respond to dark mode — demo content itself stays untouched, confirmed via AskUserQuestion this is scoped to StylePreviewCard + override components' outer card div, NOT PreviewFrame or demo internals; (2) shadow-clay's white highlight (rgba(255,255,255,0.7)) is too intense against a dark shell background and needs reduced intensity in dark mode. Both are small, well-scoped CSS/JSX-class-only changes — no new components, no new data, so this does not need the full T12-style multi-task chain.

newFeatureChains.reason: shadow-clay/-sm/-inset tokens are static @theme CSS vars — Tailwind v4 can't make a single utility class conditionally dark via @theme alone, so this needs a .dark scope override block in index.css redefining the --shadow-clay* custom properties with reduced white-highlight alpha. Pure CSS, no component logic.

Add dark: variants to the outer card div's bg/shadow classes across StylePreviewCard.tsx and every components/overrides/*.tsx file that has its own outer card wrapper (the layout-keyword and custom demos each define their own outer card since they don't go through StylePreviewCard) — mechanical, repeated small edit, no new logic. Depends on dark-shadow-tokens landing first so the shadow-clay utility itself is already dark-aware before cards start using dark:shadow-clay.

revisions.reason: Earth requested a large scope expansion after a full grill-me + Explore + Plan agent research pass (see plan file at C:\Users\mis\.claude\plans\system-reminder-the-session-s-working-peppy-frog.md, approved). Two features: (A) 3 new top-level categories (Visual Effect, Component, UX/UI Keyword glossary) plus +2 style entries to each of the 7 existing categories (54->68), (B) a new /blog section — 4 experience levels x 4 content types = 16 long-form pieces, using this project's first dynamic :param route. All major design decisions (Component category interactivity approach, About stats scope, build ordering) were confirmed with Earth via AskUserQuestion before this revision. This is the largest single expansion yet — sequenced deliberately by risk (type system -> proven-pattern style expansion -> closest-fit new category -> new-type-no-interactivity category -> highest-risk interactive category -> largest-content-lift blog section -> full regression QA) rather than parallelizing everything, since several steps depend on earlier ones proving the pattern works before scaling it.

newFeatureChains.reason: Widen CategoryId union, add optional StyleConfig.interactive field, new GlossaryTermConfig/BlogPost/BlogLevelConfig/BlogSection interfaces. Unblocks every other feature chain below — must land first, zero component work.

+2 StyleConfig entries per existing 7 category (54->68), same proven plan->data->generic-wire->custom-build->AA-verify pipeline as the prior 33->54 round. Lowest risk — validates the pipeline still works before new-category work begins.

New category (page/route/nav/categories.ts entry) but demos are CSS-only hover/animation, closest fit to the existing custom-demo pattern (e.g. GlitchcoreDemo's group-hover: idiom) — proves new-category scaffolding once in a low-risk context before Component needs the same scaffolding under harder conditions.

New GlossaryTermConfig type + new GlossaryTermCard component (reuses About.tsx's icon-badge card language, not StylePreviewCard) + new category page — validates 'new category, non-demo content' path in isolation, zero interactivity risk, before Component's harder problem.

HIGHEST RISK: first stateful demo components in the whole app (useState/useId), 9 distinct interactive patterns (modal/dropdown/tabs/accordion/toast/tooltip/pagination/breadcrumb/stepper), each built and manually verified individually (containment inside PreviewFrame per the confirmed fake-in-card no-portal approach, keyboard nav, focus states, ARIA) rather than batch-written, so a containment or a11y bug is caught before replicated across all 9.

Largest content-authoring lift (16 pieces x 300-600 words across 4 levels) and first dynamic :level route in the codebase. CopyBox extraction from StyleInfoPanel is the deliberate first sub-step (verify StyleInfoPanel still renders identically after extraction) before building Blog on top of it, per the plan's explicit sequencing.

Click through all 10 categories + Blog's 5 pages, dark/light on every new card type, confirm About's expanded stats (now including glossary term count + blog post count, confirmed with Earth) compute live and correctly.
